name: Kimpton Era Midtown
insider_take: A sleek modern sanctuary in the heart of Manhattan's most dynamic neighborhood, where Midtown's energy meets boutique sophistication.
whats_special: This stylish newcomer sits perfectly positioned between Times Square and Central Park, featuring Kimpton's signature pet-friendly policy and complimentary evening wine hours. The hotel's contemporary design pays homage to New York's architectural heritage while offering cutting-edge amenities including a state-of-the-art fitness center and modern meeting spaces.
pro_tip: Book a corner room for stunning city views and extra space - many feature floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing Manhattan's iconic skyline and bustling street life below.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime Midtown location puts you within walking distance of Broadway theaters, world-class shopping on Fifth Avenue, and iconic landmarks like Rockefeller Center. Take advantage of the complimentary bikes to explore nearby Central Park, just blocks away.
pros: Prime Midtown Manhattan location with easy access to major attractions
Kimpton's signature personalized service and boutique hospitality
Pet-friendly policy with no additional fees
Modern amenities and stylish contemporary design
cons: Premium pricing typical of Midtown Manhattan hotels
Limited outdoor space due to urban location
